Overview

Priest (Heaven) is a MythicalMythical unit that can be obtainable through evolving by using Heavenly Clock on Priest (New Moon).

Evolving

Priest (Heaven) can be evolved from Priest (New Moon) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Priest (New Moon)
x1 Heavenly Clock

Priest
(Heaven)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 10,000 (only on Cape Canaveral content, including New Moon portals) Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Time Acceleration

Priest (Heaven) decreases the SPA of all units in the map for the duration when used.

  • SPA Decrease: 50%
  • Duration: 30 Seconds
  • Global Cooldown: 300 Seconds


Note that this does not stack with Trickster's ability (only the SPA part). However, this boost doesn't work on units whose SPA is lower than their actual attack animation.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Priest (Heaven)'s shiny skin could possibly be based on the video "Made In Heaven Test Animation" by Vehgeto as they both similarly share the same Black & White artstyle.
  • All of his upgrade costs are prime numbers, befitting the character's personality.
    • As a result, his cost in high cost contracts and challenges contains a decimal.
  • From update 19.0, he has received a 100% damage buff, increasing his overall damage.
  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
